name: National MILO Marathon 2026 – Bacolod Leg
short_description: A half-marathon and multi-distance race event held in Bacolod City, Philippines on October 4, 2026, organized by RUNRIO Inc.
ai_summary: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Bacolod Leg is a race event scheduled for October 4, 2026, in Bacolod City, Philippines. Organized by RUNRIO Inc. under the MILO Marathon banner, it offers multiple distance options including 1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, and the primary half-marathon distance of 21.1km. Registration status for this leg has not yet been confirmed as open.
pros: Multiple distance options available, from 1km to a 21.1km half-marathon, suiting a range of runner abilities
Organized by RUNRIO Inc., the established organizer behind the MILO Marathon series
Held in Bacolod City, offering a specific regional leg of the national event
cons: Registration status is not yet confirmed as open, so participation details are currently unavailable
research_highlights: The 2026 Bacolod leg is scheduled for October 4, 2026, one of 15 regional qualifying races in the MILO Marathon's 50th Anniversary 'Golden Run' calendar leading to the National Finals on Dec. 6, 2026 in Clark City, Pampanga.

Race categories in the Bacolod leg have included 3K, 5K, 10K, 21K and 42K distances, with finisher shirts and lootbags exclusive to 21K/42K finishers and finisher medals for 10K/21K/42K finishers in the 2024 edition.
The race is organized by RUNRIO Inc. with local partners in each host city, and registration/logistics (packet pick-up, transfers, refunds) are handled through Race Roster.

Official race mechanics specify that participants who do not start within 10 minutes of their category's flag-off are disqualified, and elite/competitive runners are advised to be at the starting line at least 15 minutes before gun time.
Bacolod has long been a recurring qualifying leg in the Milo Marathon series, having hosted eliminations in past decades (e.g., referenced as far back as the 36th edition).

faqs.question: When is the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Bacolod Leg taking place?
faqs.answer: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Bacolod Leg is scheduled to take place on October 4, 2026. The event will be held in Bacolod City, Philippines, as one of the regional legs of the broader MILO Marathon series organized nationwide by RUNRIO Inc.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: This race offers a range of distance options for participants, including 1km, 3km, 5km, and 10km races, along with the primary distance of 21.1km, which is a half-marathon. This variety allows runners of different experience levels to take part.

faqs.answer: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Bacolod Leg is organized by RUNRIO Inc., which runs the MILO Marathon series. RUNRIO Inc. is responsible for organizing this event as part of the broader national MILO Marathon program held across the Philippines.
